title: Animated Switches MicroSim
description: Interactive circuit simulation demonstrating how horizontal and vertical switches control the flow of electric current in a series circuit, with animated electron visualization
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Electric Circuits
Switches
Current Flow
Series Circuits
Electron Animation
learningObjectives: Explain how opening a switch breaks the conducting path and halts electron flow around the loop
Predict whether current flows for each of the four on/off combinations of the horizontal and vertical switches
Explain why two switches wired in series both must be closed for current to flow
Compare the electron animation at different speed and spacing settings to relate electron movement to current magnitude
Distinguish an open circuit from a closed circuit by observing whether electrons continue around the loop
